title: 第三千八百九十章再见了老一辈修士第三千八百八十九章团结就是力量
content_zh:
与此同时，苍穹星的所有老一辈修士们，都在这一刻，以燃烧生命精血为代价，飞入星辰之中。
他们知道，只有这样才能让新生代的修士们能够有机会创造出更加美好的新宇宙。
顿时，星之宇宙的众多修士们，都在这一刻为之落泪。
而让苏阳意想不到的是，就连自己的师傅黎沧海，也在这一刻，以毫无存在感的方式燃烧生命精华，飞入了星辰之中，或许没人注意到他的存在，但苏阳却能够清晰感受得到。
至尊学院内，孟正天交代完一些事情后，也同样率领当年的十大天帝飞入了星辰之中。
一道道熟悉的身影，就这样消失在了众人眼前，消失在了苏阳眼前。
眼看越来越多的老一辈即将消散，苏阳甚至都不忍心将这颗凝聚出来的星辰彻底释放。
一旦爆发，星辰中所蕴含的能量，足以将一切化为虚无。
而随着众多修士们以生命为代价所涌入星辰之中时，原本就巨大的星辰在这一刻更加遮天蔽日，仿佛整个宇宙世界都无法容纳这颗可怕的星辰。
星辰所散发出来的光芒极其耀眼，甚至都让黑暗宇宙中的黑暗都不断消散。
而那些宇宙黑暗巨人们，更是在星光的照耀之下，不断变弱，就连所散发出来的黑暗魔神之威，也不像先前那般恐怖。
黑暗主神见状，知道再这样下去，苏阳所凝聚出来的星辰只会越来越恐怖，说不定还真能抵挡住自己以及宇宙黑暗巨人的攻击。
于是，他来不及等待，只能将已经所凝聚而成的黑暗能量球，再加上一尊尊宇宙黑暗巨人嘴里的黑暗能量炮，释放而出。
“苏阳，来吧，就让我们看看到底谁所释放出来的招式更加强大。”
“我要让你，还有你身边的那些修士们，全都灰飞烟灭。”
“杀！！！！”
话音落下，黑暗主神将凝聚出来的黑暗能量球朝着星辰扔了过去。
与此同时，一尊尊宇宙黑暗巨人嘴里所凝聚出来的黑暗能量炮，也在此刻同时释放，爆发融合。
轰隆！！！
能量划破星空，将一切化为虚无，配合黑暗主神所释放出来的黑暗能量球，更是无比害人。

苏阳见状，也只能将凝聚而出来的星辰，朝着身下急速飞来的黑暗能量球以及融合在一起的黑暗能量炮，丢了下去。
“给我爆！！！！”
“喝呀！！”
话音落下，耀眼的星辰以碾压之势缓缓坠落，就连苏阳的身躯都被淹没在星光之中。
恐怖的永恒神力肆虐爆发，扩散至宇宙世界各个角落，霸气缠绕的力量更是无比害人，一道道黑色闪电在宇宙世界中形成了末日景象，每一道轰隆之声，都足以让半步神祇境强者化为虚无。
这一刻，全世界都仿佛停止了转动，所有人的呼吸声，跳动声戛然而止。
就连目光也死死落在星空之中，仿佛下一秒整个宇宙世界都会支离破碎。
而看见这一幕的麒凌风等人，同样屏住呼吸，不敢大声喘气。
天子双拳紧握，发出难以置信的声音道：“好恐怖的手段，好恐怖的星辰，这真的是苏阳所能释放出来的招式之威吗？”
“怕是连我们的神祇族长也只能做到这一步了吧？”
“天呐！这可恶的小子，怎么会如此变态妖孽？”
“该死！！！”
听到天子的话，天琊圣主早就吓得浑身颤抖。
他实在无法想象苏阳究竟有多么变态与强大，即便是借助了三大宇宙修士们的神力，但能够释放出这种级别的招式，除了真正强大的神祇之外，恐怕无人能够做到了吧？
哪怕是黑暗主神所释放出来的黑暗能量，也远比不上苏阳的九转星辰诀之威啊。
要不是有几十尊宇宙黑暗巨人的恐怖黑暗能量射线，恐怕光是这一招之威，就足以让整个黑暗宇宙烟消云散。
其余主宰神盟的盟员们，更是噤若寒蝉，一个个浑身颤栗，因为他们知道，一旦让苏阳与黑暗主神所释放出来的招式之威碰撞爆发，即便他们远在死灵院外，也同样会受到波及，说不定会因此化为虚无。
躲在暗处的裂天神祇也一样感觉到了窒息。
他实在无法想象，苏阳不过是宇宙之主，虽然有着神祇的战斗力，但却由于宇宙规则与秩序的限制，不可能爆发出超越神祇的手段。
可眼前这一幕已经让裂天神祇有些怀疑人生了，即便是在禁区之战中，除了五大创世始祖之外，也没有谁的手段如此恐怖。

但要知道，那时候的宇宙世界是没有受到神祇所压制的，所以能施展此等手段也很正常。
content_en:
At the same time, all the older generation of monks in the Firmament Star flew into the stars at this moment, at the cost of burning their life essence and blood.
They know that only in this way can the new generation of monks have the opportunity to create a better new universe.
Suddenly, many monks in the Star Universe shed tears at this moment.
What Su Yang didn't expect was that at this moment, even his master Li Canghai burned his life essence in a non-existent way and flew into the stars. Perhaps no one noticed his existence, but Su Yang could clearly feel it.
In the Supreme Academy, after Meng Zhengtian explained some things, he also led the ten emperors of the year to fly into the stars.
Familiar figures disappeared in front of everyone and Su Yang.
Seeing that more and more of the older generation were about to disappear, Su Yang couldn't even bear to completely release this condensed star.
Once it explodes, the energy contained in the stars is enough to turn everything into nothingness.
And as many monks poured into the stars at the cost of their lives, the already huge stars became even more obscured at this moment, as if the entire universe could not accommodate this terrible star.
The light emitted by the stars was extremely dazzling, even causing the darkness in the dark universe to continue to dissipate.
And those dark giants of the universe are constantly weakening under the shining of starlight, and even the power of the dark demon emanating from them is not as terrifying as before.
Seeing this, the Lord of Darkness knew that if this continued, the stars condensed by Su Yang would only become more and more terrifying, and they might actually be able to withstand the attacks of himself and the dark giant of the universe.
Therefore, he had no time to wait, so he could only release the dark energy ball that had been condensed, plus the dark energy cannon in the mouth of the dark giant of the universe.
"Su Yang, come on, let's see who unleashes more powerful moves."
"I want you, and the monks around you, to be wiped out in ashes."
"Kill!!!"
After the words fell, the Lord of Darkness threw the condensed dark energy ball towards the stars.
At the same time, the dark energy cannons condensed from the mouths of the dark giants of the universe were also released at the same time, bursting into fusion.
Boom! ! !
The energy cuts through the starry sky and turns everything into nothingness. Combined with the dark energy ball released by the Lord of Darkness, it is extremely harmful.
Seeing this, Su Yang could only throw the condensed stars towards the dark energy balls flying rapidly under him and the fused dark energy cannon.
"Blow it up!!!"
"Drink!!"
As the words fell, the dazzling stars slowly fell with a crushing force, and even Su Yang's body was submerged in the starlight.
The terrifying eternal divine power broke out wildly and spread to every corner of the universe. The domineering power was even more harmful. Black lightning formed a doomsday scene in the universe. Every rumbling sound was enough to turn a half-step god-level expert into nothingness.
At this moment, the whole world seemed to have stopped spinning, and everyone's breathing and beating stopped suddenly.
Even his eyes were fixed on the starry sky, as if the entire universe would be shattered in the next second.
When Qi Lingfeng and others saw this scene, they also held their breath and did not dare to gasp loudly.
The emperor clenched his fists and said in an unbelievable voice: "What a terrifying method, what a terrifying star. Is this really the power of the moves that Su Yang can unleash?"
"I'm afraid even our gods and clan leaders can only do this, right?"
"Oh my God! How could this damn boy be so perverted and evil?"
"Damn!!!"
Upon hearing the emperor's words, Holy Lord Tianya was already trembling with fear.
He really couldn't imagine how perverted and powerful Su Yang was., even with the help of the divine power of the three major universe monks, except for the truly powerful gods, probably no one can release such a level of moves, right?
Even the dark energy released by the Lord of Darkness is far inferior to the power of Su Yang's Nine Turns Star Art.
If it weren't for the terrifying dark energy rays of dozens of cosmic dark giants, the power of this move alone would be enough to make the entire dark universe disappear.
The rest of the members of the Dominion God Alliance were even more silent and trembling, because they knew that once the power of the moves released by Su Yang and the Lord of Darkness collided, they would be affected even if they were far outside the Academy of the Dead, and they might be reduced to nothingness.
The Sky-Splitting God hiding in the dark also felt suffocated.
He really couldn't imagine that Su Yang was just the master of the universe. Although he had the fighting power of a god, due to the limitations of the rules and order of the universe, it was impossible to use means that surpassed the gods.
But the scene in front of him has already made the God of Splitting Heaven doubt his life. Even in the battle in the restricted area, except for the five founders, no one's methods were so terrifying.
But you must know that the universe at that time was not suppressed by the gods, so it was normal to be able to use such methods.
